glossary.Cities: City chooser and destination list. Use ‘map’ on controls and ‘atlas’ for the geographic section.
glossary.Arrival: Published flight details for the trip. Airport codes can stay in flight schedules.
glossary.Stays: Apartment and lodging options. ‘Listing’ opens the property’s actual gallery or booking site.
glossary.Walks: Selected pedestrian route and transport information.
glossary.Public starting point: Routing starts from a named public location. Use modeled start and distance caveats where shown.
glossary.Estimated walk: A modeled walking time and distance. Keep minutes and kilometers attached to their numbers.
glossary.Satellite and Diagram: Two backgrounds for the same selected route. Google Maps and Apple Maps supply online directions.
glossary.Winter: Date-specific conditions and choices. A ‘preview’ is an optional Stageshow presentation.
glossary.Itinerary: Daily trip plan. An ‘alternative’ is the backup plan.
glossary.Budget: Trip costs in SAR. ‘Per adult’ is individual. ‘For three’ is one shared amount.
glossary.Photos: Real destination photography with source, photographer and license. Never call place imagery a specific rental photo.
glossary.Compare: Two trips and their current estimated costs side by side.
glossary.Outdoor space: Distinguish private, shared, public nearby and unverified access.
glossary.Sources: Original authorities, dated observations and methodology.
